'''Alia Terae''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Terae was the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and weapons officer aboard the [[Aegis (Alderaanian gunship)|Aegis]], an [[Alderaanian gunship]] that managed to escape the blast that destroyed [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Terae firmly believed that it was the royal family's association with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that led to the planet's destruction. She and the rest of the Aegis crew turned to piracy to fight the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on their own terms rather than join the Rebel Alliance. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the Aegis ran into the Alderaanian princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who tried to convince the crew of the Aegis to give up piracy. Following the death of the Aegis's captain, [[Caline Metara]], Terae and the Aegis's second-in-command decide to join the Rebel Alliance.
